citations.claim: after ceiling bounce vy magnitude increased despite gravity should decrease upward speed
energy growing faster than gravity work
first violation step 3 energy exceeds allowed 1074.16

counterfactual.change: changed body e from 1.0 to 0.0 (single field) to remove elastic energy injection at ceiling bounce; same dt, steps, gravity; scenario now passes with energy_final=153.6 < initial

explanation: Shrunk case is a single body with e=1 starting just below ceiling (y=11.6, r~0.30, ceiling at 12) moving upward at ~40 m/s with dt~0.0287. It hits ceiling within step 1, triggering many substeps (40+). After bounce, |vy| grows from 40.47 to 40.73 to 42.42 to 44.12, faster than gravity alone (g*dt~0.28). Mechanical energy rises from E0=971.9 to 973.0 to 1031.7 to 1092.7 at step 3, exceeding allowed E0*1.1+5=1074.16. Likely cause: restitution=1 collision with implicit arena boundary plus positional correction injects energy when resolved inside substeps, compounding each step. Lowering e to 0 removes bounce energy injection.
vision_note: A single ball starts almost touching the top ceiling and rebounds downward. Between steps 2 and 3 it falls a noticeably larger distance than between 0-1 and 1-2, showing an anomalous gain in speed after the ceiling hit.
